passages.text: My cousin in Canada helps her class run a stall at the school fair. They sell slices of apple pie, with sweet fruit inside a baked pastry case. Each slice costs one dollar, and the price is written clearly beside the tray. Mia serves the slices while Ben puts each payment into a box. Another pupil records every sale so they can check the money afterwards. They work in short turns so everyone has time to see the other stalls. Sharing clear jobs helps the children serve visitors and keep track of their class project.

parallelText.en: My cousin in Canada helps her class run a stall at the school fair.
parallelText.zh: 我在加拿大的表亲帮助班级在校园展会上摆摊。

parallelText.en: Each slice costs one dollar, and the price is written clearly beside the tray.
parallelText.zh: 每片价格为一加元，价签清楚写在托盘旁。

parallelText.en: Mia serves the slices while Ben puts each payment into a box.
parallelText.zh: 米娅给顾客分发派片，本把每笔付款放进盒子。

parallelText.en: Another pupil records every sale so they can check the money afterwards.
parallelText.zh: 另一名学生记录每笔销售，便于之后核对钱。

parallelText.en: They work in short turns so everyone has time to see the other stalls.
parallelText.zh: 他们分短时轮班，让每个人有时间看看其他摊位。

parallelText.en: Sharing clear jobs helps the children serve visitors and keep track of their class project.
parallelText.zh: 清晰分工让孩子们既能接待访客，又能记录好班级项目。

passages.text: Our annual science show takes place once every year in the school hall. Each group prepares a model and explains one question it wants to investigate. This year, our group shows how different paper wings change a model plane's flight. Visitors try two versions and tell us what they notice. One younger pupil calls the show fantastic because she can ask questions and test ideas herself. Her questions give us a new idea to try after the show. The display for this year ends, but we still have more ideas to explore.

parallelText.en: Our annual science show takes place once every year in the school hall.
parallelText.zh: 我们一年一度的科学展每年在学校大厅举办一次。

parallelText.en: Each group prepares a model and explains one question it wants to investigate.
parallelText.zh: 每组准备一个模型，说明想探究的一个问题。

parallelText.en: This year, our group shows how different paper wings change a model plane's flight.
parallelText.zh: 今年，我们组展示不同纸机翼怎样改变模型飞机的飞行。

parallelText.en: Visitors try two versions and tell us what they notice.
parallelText.zh: 访客试两种版本，告诉我们观察结果。

parallelText.en: One younger pupil calls the show fantastic because she can ask questions and test ideas herself.
parallelText.zh: 一位小同学说展览太棒了，因为她能自己提问、检验想法。

parallelText.en: Her questions give us a new idea to try after the show.
parallelText.zh: 她的问题给了我们展后想尝试的新点子。

parallelText.en: The display for this year ends, but we still have more ideas to explore.
parallelText.zh: 今年的展示结束了，但我们仍有更多想法要探索。
